cards.title: Model Evaluation Standards: Verification and Validation
cards.claim: Model evaluation must include Verification (ensuring code/equations are error-free) and Validation/Applicability Assessment (assessing performance/robustness). Evaluation must be commensurate with Model Risk. Key activities include assessing data relevance, model structure consistency with knowledge, and external validation.
conditions: Verification of user-generated code is mandatory
Validation must assess adequacy/relevance of data and model assumptions
External validation is encouraged and may be essential depending on risk
required_inputs: Description of model assumptions and alternatives considered
limitations: High-level recommendations; specific technical standards depend on the M&S method used
Does not define specific goodness-of-fit metrics for specific model types
cards.downstream_use: Guiding the technical execution of PK/PD model building, ensuring code integrity and scientific justification for model structure and parameters.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
